FIELDS.NAME: Green Horizon Landscaping
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Horizon Landscaping specializes in providing high-quality garden and landscaping services primarily focused on residential properties. Our core operations include routine lawn care, garden design, planting, and maintenance. We pride ourselves on using sustainable practices and fostering relationships with licensed nurseries to ensure a variety of healthy plant selections. Our team is certified in proper handling and application of pesticides and herbicides, ensuring that any chemical use is done responsibly and in accordance with local regulations. Additionally, we prioritize safety through documented training for all employees, rigorous equipment maintenance, and clear contracts with our clients to define the scope of work. Overall, our focus is on low-risk, predictable operations that enhance the aesthetic and ecological value of our clients' outdoor spaces.

FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Green Horizon Landscaping carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance and protect our employees during their work. This policy is active and meets legal requirements.

FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Green Horizon Landscaping currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company aside from the ones already listed. All required coverage is up to date and maintained according to legal and operational requirements.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Green Horizon Landscaping is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing garden and landscaping services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Green Horizon Landscaping does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is on providing services directly to our clients without involving external parties in equipment usage.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Green Horizon Landscaping has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial standing and has not encountered any major financial issues.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Green Horizon Landscaping does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are primarily focused on routine garden and landscaping services without significant risks associated with catastrophic events. We prioritize safety and compliance in all aspects of our business.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Green Horizon Landscaping has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a commitment to ethical practices and compliance in all operations.
